note: Hand-written: the connection succeeds (200, text/event-stream) and the turn starts normally — a signed thinking block, then a text block streaming an answer — but instead of completing, Anthropic sends a mid-stream `event: error` carrying `overloaded_error`. Because the HTTP response already succeeded, SDK-level retries never see this; the SDK surfaces it from inside the SSE parser as a bare APIError with `status: undefined` (see errors.ts `isOverloadedError`). Pair with a normal fixture (e.g. `plain-text`) as the second exchange to play the retried request's response.
